name: vane-1-pilot
purpose: Round-5 pilot: learn whether the pipeline improves cross-language retrieval. Not a release candidate; nothing from it ships until the base-model audit is decided.

data.rule: public domain, CC0, CC-BY, EU reuse texts and teacher-generated text only; no CC-BY-SA; nothing from nai-bench

command: docker compose -f training/docker/compose.rocm.yaml run --rm trainer sh -c 'timeout 3h python3 training/embed/train.py --pairs training/data/vane1-pilot/pairs-clean.jsonl --output-dir training/runs/vane1-pilot --release vane-1-pilot --epochs 1 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 2e-5 --max-seq-length 256 --hard-negatives 1 --eval-steps 100 --seed 13 --no-export > training/runs/vane1-pilot/train.log 2>&1'
limits: unattended, capped at 3 hours (timeout 3h), log in training/runs/vane1-pilot/train.log
evaluation: evals/embeddings/dense_eval.py on the v1 dev split only (base vs pilot), next to the nAI hybrid baseline
